definitions.explanation: The process of adapting a novel, manga, or other source material into a television drama series. A common practice in Japanese entertainment.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ドラマ{化|か}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: That novel was adapted into a TV drama.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧マンガ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ドラマ{化|か}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決定|けってい}した→決定する：21022_ketteisuru⟧。
examples.english: It was decided that the popular manga will be adapted into a drama.

examples.japanese: ドラマ{化|か}⟦にあたって→にあたって：22936_niatatte⟧、⟦{原作|げんさく}→原作：11827_gensaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ストーリー→ストーリー：11018_sutoorii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: When adapting into a drama, the original story sometimes changes significantly.

notes:
A compound of ⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧ (drama, i.e., TV drama series) + ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ (transformation, -ization). In Japan, adapting manga and novels into live-action TV dramas is extremely common and often generates significant buzz. The suffix ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ is productive and attaches to many nouns to mean 'turning into X.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ドラマ{化|か}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be adapted into a drama (passive)
- ドラマ{化|か}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決定|けってい}→決定：02701_kettei⟧: drama adaptation confirmed
- ドラマ{化|か}⟦にあたって→にあたって：22936_niatatte⟧: in adapting into a drama
- ⟦{実写|じっしゃ}→実写：12271_jissha⟧ドラマ{化|か}: live-action drama adaptation

SIMILAR PATTERNS:
- ⟦{映画化|えいがか}→映画化：23773_eigaka⟧: film adaptation
- ⟦{アニメ化|あにめか}→アニメ化：23065_animeka⟧: anime adaptation
- {舞台化|ぶたいか}: stage adaptation
- {漫画化|まんがか}: manga adaptation (reverse direction)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese TV dramas (typically 10-12 episodes per season) are a major entertainment format. Successful adaptations of manga and novels often boost sales of the original work dramatically.
